zajjaj:1-1.t:
Sūrat al-Tīn
Meccan
﷽
His saying: ﴿والتِّينِ والزَّيْتُونِ﴾ ("by the fig and the olive"): it was said: ”اَلتِّينُ“ is Damascus and ”اَلزَّيْتُونُ“ is Jerusalem (Bayt al-Maqdis). And it was said: ”اَلتِّينُ“ is a mountain on which Damascus stands, and ”اَلزَّيْتُونُ“ is a mountain on which Jerusalem stands. And it was said: ”والتِّينُ“ and ”اَلزَّيْتُونُ“ are two mountains. And it was said: ”اَلتِّينُ“ and ”اَلزَّيْتُونُ“ are this fig that we know and this olive that we know.

zajjaj:2-2.t: ﴿وَطُورِ سِينِينَ﴾ ("and by Mount Sīnīn"): a mountain. Some read: ”وَطُورِ سَيْناءَ“; and this statement — and Allah knows best — is more fitting, because of His saying: ﴿وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْناءَ تَنْبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ﴾ [al-Muʾminūn: 20] ("and a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil").

zajjaj:3-3.t: ﴿وَهَذا البَلَدِ الأمِينِ﴾ ("and by this secure town"): He means Mecca.

zajjaj:4-4.t: ﴿لَقَدْ خَلَقْنا الإنْسانَ في أحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ﴾ ("We have certainly created the human being in the best stature"): that is, in the best form.

zajjaj:5-5.t:
﴿ثُمَّ رَدَدْناهُ أسْفَلَ سافِلِينَ﴾ ("then We returned him to the lowest of the low"): to the most decrepit age; and it was said: to misguidance, as He, Mighty and Majestic is He, said: ﴿إنَّ الإنْسانَ لَفي خُسْرٍ﴾ [al-ʿAṣr: 2] ﴿إلا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وعَمِلُوا الصّالِحاتِ﴾ [al-ʿAṣr: 3] ("the human being is surely in loss, except those who believe and do righteous deeds"). And it is — and Allah knows best — that the creation of creatures is upon the natural disposition (fiṭra), so whoever disbelieves and goes astray is the one returned to the lowest of the low.
﴿إلا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وعَمِلُوا الصّالِحاتِ﴾ [al-Tīn: 6]: that is, except these, for they are not returned to the lowest of the low.

zajjaj:6-6.t: And His saying: ﴿فَلَهم أجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ﴾: that is, it is not held up to them as a favour (lā yumannu ʿalayhim); and it was said: ”غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ“ means "uninterrupted". And the answer to the oath in His saying ﴿والتِّينِ والزَّيْتُونِ﴾ [al-Tīn: 1] is His saying: ﴿لَقَدْ خَلَقْنا الإنْسانَ في أحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ﴾ [al-Tīn: 4].
